title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Pick rock, paper or scissors and see if you can beat the house's random choice to build up your score. Free and quick to play in your browser.
about:
Rock Paper Scissors brings the playground classic to your screen with big, colorful buttons and smooth animations. You make your pick, the house reveals its own choice a moment later, and the winner is highlighted with a glowing ring.

Every win adds a point to your score and every loss takes one away, while a draw leaves it unchanged. The house chooses completely at random, so there is no pattern to exploit, just luck and nerve as you try to push your streak higher.

It is a relaxed game for anyone with a spare minute, easy enough for kids and quick enough to settle a friendly bet. A Rules button is always there if you need a reminder of what beats what.
howToPlay: Click or tap rock, paper or scissors to make your move. The house then picks at random: paper beats rock, rock beats scissors and scissors beats paper. Win to gain a point, lose to drop one, and press Play Again for the next round.
tips: The house picks completely at random, so no move is better than another in the long run.
Your score never drops below zero, so an early loss costs you nothing.
Set yourself a target, like reaching 10 points, to turn a random game into a real challenge.
Open the Rules panel if you ever forget which hand beats which.

faq.question: Is Rock Paper Scissors free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. It is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The layout adapts to small screens and you simply tap the move you want.

faq.question: Does the house cheat?
faq.answer: No. The house makes its choice at random before you pick, so every round is a fair game of chance. Your score resets when you reload the page.
